hooks.logic:
Let resultObjectsInFrame be the results "on_damaged_for_buddy" this frame.
The enemy gains [the HASTE status, the SHELL status].
If condition flag "on_damage" is up this frame, then increase the register's 'onDamageCount' by one.
If condition flag "cloudy_heaven" is up this frame, then
  Set the register's 'onDamageCount' to 0.
  Set the register's 'alreadyUsedCloudyHeaven' to true.
  If the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0, then run helper3 on resultObjectsInFrame.
If the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0, then run helper4 on resultObjectsInFrame.
Let bpConfsIdx be the register's 'bpConfsIdx'.
Let v be run helper.
If bpConfsIdx is not v, then
  Run helper2 on v.
  The enemy cancels its cast and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let v2 be unset.
  Let onDamageCount be the register's 'onDamageCount'.
  Let number be the numeric entry "count_to_use_cloudy_heaven" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
  Set v2 to if not the register's 'alreadyUsedCloudyHeaven' and number is at most onDamageCount then the id of the move labelled "cloudy_heaven" on the enemy else a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  The enemy uses v2.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled "cloudy_heaven" on the enemy.
Let v be the items x in arg where not not x's 'ability'.
If the length of v is not 0, then
  Let onDamagedCloudyHeavenBuddyNoMap be the script register's 'onDamagedCloudyHeavenBuddyNoMap'.
  For each x in v
    If the value "abilityId" of v at 0's 'ability' is ability, then
      Let v2 be the value "no" of x's 'receiver'.
      Set onDamagedCloudyHeavenBuddyNoMap at v2 to 1.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let onDamagedCloudyHeavenBuddyNoMap be the register's 'onDamagedCloudyHeavenBuddyNoMap'.
For each x in arg
  Let v be the value "no" of x's 'receiver'.
  If onDamagedCloudyHeavenBuddyNoMap at v is not 0 and x's 'type' is game:Conf.CALC_TYPE.HEAL_DEATH, then
    Set onDamagedCloudyHeavenBuddyNoMap at v to 0.
    Call game:ActorMgr.getBuddyByNo with (v) gains the CONFUSION status.
